methodologyNotes: Re-verified 2026-06-18 via WebFetch on official pricing pages and WebSearch corroboration. Apollo.io (/pricing rendered without the dynamic table; tiers corroborated on apollo.io security page + salesmotion.io/blog/apollo-pricing and multiple 2026 breakdowns: Basic $59/mo monthly / $49/mo annual, Professional $99/$79, Organization $149/$119). Lusha, Hunter (EUR-denominated), Snov.io, Kaspr, Seamless.AI, Cognism fetched directly. RocketReach /pricing did not render via WebFetch; monthly $49/$99/$209 and annual $329/$829/$1,699 corroborated via salesmotion.io 2026 breakdown and search consensus. ZoomInfo /pricing is 403/quote-only — confirmed no public price, no free tier, no self-serve trial via search. Quote-only vendors (ZoomInfo, Cognism) and quote-only tiers (Lusha Enterprise, Hunter Enterprise, Snov Custom Ultra, Kaspr Enterprise, Seamless Pro/Enterprise, RocketReach Team) have monthlyUsd=null. Clearbit (now HubSpot Breeze Intelligence) excluded as a HubSpot add-on, not a standalone product. CORRECTIONS THIS PASS: Kaspr Starter/Business monthlyUsd corrected to the month-to-month billing price ($65/$99); the $49/$79 figures the draft used are the annual-billing effective rates, not the monthly-billing price (Kaspr displays the higher month-to-month figure struck through with a 25%-off annual toggle). Cognism GDPR source URL moved from /pricing (does not substantiate compliance) to /compliance. accessedAt 2026-06-18.
